Tap any skill and begin a session of work. Sessions carry on in the background, even with the app closed. Come back to gather your wages and XP.

Quarry ore to cast ingots, then found better tools of the craft and regalia. Wear finer regalia to face harder Trial Grounds and Great Trials. Better tools speed up gathering, and higher-tier equipment opens work that rough gear can\'t withstand.
Complete quests to earn XP rewards. Rare emblems may appear while you work your skills and grant permanent XP boosts.
An idle game of the Craft inspired by classic MMORPGs. Hone your skills, face the Trials, and shape your regalia. All offline, no accounts, no ads.
Take on an Apprentice to work your skills for you, or order food from the daily menu. Apprentices do not count toward your quests.
An Apprentice is already at work.
Apprentice taken on and at work
One job per hire, dismissed after collecting. 8h gathering, 0.5x efficiency, unlimited crafting qty. Slow, but willing to do anything.
One job per hire, dismissed after collecting. 8h gathering, 1x efficiency. Crafting, Reflection and Symbolism capped at 480 items per session.
One job per hire, dismissed after collecting. 6h gathering, 1.5x efficiency. Crafting, Reflection and Symbolism capped at 540 items per session.
One job per hire, dismissed after collecting. 4h gathering, 2.5x efficiency. Crafting, Reflection and Symbolism capped at 600 items per session.
Gathering: session hours x efficiency multiplier applied to loot and XP
Crafting/Reflection/Symbolism: quantity capped per tier; the Hodman has no cap

Lodges reward you for the work you already do. Complete quests and daily requests to earn materials from other skills, coins and XP, so that specialists can still reach the fruits of skills they don\'t practise.

Grace of the Great Architect II
Long-forgotten galleries beneath the foothills, where the first stones of the Temple were cut. Copper veins still glitter in the dark.
The deepest level of an ancient operative quarry. Rich veins of rare metal lie behind the marks the old masons left in the rock.
A primeval grove where acacias have grown undisturbed for thousands of years. Something whispers a forgotten word between the branches.
A forest where darkness has replaced the light. The trees weep black sap and the air smells of old superstition.
A sea cave carved by centuries of tides. Two strange stone pillars rise from the water.
A still black lagoon with no visible bottom. The fish here glow faintly and dissolve within minutes of being caught.
A crumbling tower left unfinished when its builders no longer understood one another. Something still guards what was once stored inside.
The remains of a hermetic adept\'s great pillar, reduced to a field of rubble. The air still hums with forgotten symbols.
A maze of tunnels beneath the streets of the City, where a band of ruffians plots in the dark.
A hidden vault beneath the Sanctum of False Brothers, where the ruffians keep their most precious stolen treasures.

Trade everyday goods at the City market. Returns are modest but variable.
Float goods down the river, as the cedars once floated to the Temple. Profits are unpredictable but often worthwhile.
Join a caravan coming from the East, where the light rises. The long journey pays well when the deal goes through.
Trade at the legendary Grand Exchange, where fortunes are made and lost.
Trade rare commodities in the prestigious merchants\' district.
Send precious cargo to the harbour of Tyre, city of Hiram. High risk, high reward.
Select bones to lay upon the altar
Build furniture using planks and nails to gain XP. Higher Architecture levels let you improve the City\'s buildings for permanent bonuses.

Collect donations for the Widow\'s Alms Box each session. Success chance depends on your level vs the donor. A refusal earns nothing that minute. Better alms boxes raise both success chance and XP. Generous donors give rare items and large purses.
